newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - July 14.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - July 14.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

CSR Ltd said on Monday it expected an improvement in profit for the year to March 31, 1998. It said results from the first quarter supported this expectation of stronger full year profits. It also said that signs of improvement in the housing industry were encouraging but the recovery was patchy to date and tilted towards high rise apartments.

Britain's Imperial Chemical Industries Plc said on Friday that the global offer of 143 million shares representing its 62.34 percent stake in ICI Australia Ltd ICI.AX had been "significantly oversubscribed." In a statement it said it had fixed an offer price of A$12.35 per share, with the retail price fixed at A$11.95.

Cinema and theme park group Village Roadshow Ltd is looking at listing a A$200 million property trust to take its Australian cinemas off balance sheet and fund aggressive expansion plans, The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reported on Monday. "Village is looking to sell up to 10 stand-alone cinema sites it owns or part-owns in Sydney and Melbourne into the trust," the Herald said.
The stakeholders in pay-television operators Foxtel and Australis Media have reached in-principle agreement to merge their operations, the Australian Financial Review (AFR) reported on Monday.

Australia's Lanes Ltd said itS Bristol Paints unit will merge with Taubmans Pty Ltd, which operates the Taubmans decorative and architectural paint business in Australia, through Lanes acquiring Taubmans from South Africa's Barlow Ltd.
